rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for causing someone to feel frightened or horrified.

example.english: That horror movie really did horrify me last night.
example.traditional: 昨晚嗰套恐怖片真係嚇親我。
example.jyutping: zok6 maan5 go2 tou3 hung2 bou3 pin2 zan1 hai6 haak3 can1 ngo5

rows.note: Use this when stressing that the person is badly shaken or traumatised rather than merely frightened.

example.english: That accident was enough to horrify all of us.
example.traditional: 嗰單意外真係嚇壞晒我哋。
example.jyutping: go2 daan1 ji3 ngoi6 zan1 hai6 haak3 waai6 saai3 ngo5 dei6
